A current full browser is enough for every lesson. Practices without a model ask for a written artifact. A small quantized model is the first live step, and only if your machine has the memory. Fine-tuning is optional and comes after the eval says you need it.

Yes, with a local model, or with synthetic tasks and an explicit 'not run' on live scores if you are honest in the log.

Lesson 04

Which model should I install?

Why it matters

A small instruct model whose license you have read, in a size that fits your memory.

Try it: Flashcards

Lesson
04 of 08

4 min
Level

Fit

Smaller than your pride

This course does not crown a vendor. School 01 lists the roles — frontier, reasoning, open-weight, small, embedding, coding agent — and School 03 tells you how to pick a size. Pin the id in your notes and score it on your tasks. Re-check names; they move.

Check

Why will the course not name a single best model?

Show the answer

Because the right model depends on the task, the hardware, the license, and the date. The decision procedure is more durable than a shopping pick.

Why it matters

No. The capstone folder is the evidence.

Try it: Flashcards

There is no exam board behind this file. If you want to show the work, share the capstone: tasks, policy page, scorecard, and a trace with secrets removed. A badge would say less.

Related reading lives in the repository README: how to download the file, how the tracks connect, and how to adapt the course.

Check

What can you show a hiring manager instead of a certificate?

Show the answer

A capstone you can demo: a citation, a refusal, a trace, and a scorecard you can explain.
